helpCenter.collectionMemo.headline: Remember how far you have collected each target
helpCenter.collectionMemo.intro: Manually record collected date ranges for a website, author, or other collection target. Green shows collected time and gray shows uncollected time. Overlapping ranges appear as a continuous collected region.
helpCenter.collectionMemo.steps.title: Start recording
helpCenter.collectionMemo.step.target.de: Create a target with a recognizable name. You can search, rename, or delete targets. Deleting a target also deletes all its ranges.
helpCenter.collectionMemo.step.range.des: Enter an end time. Leave the start blank to use the global start time, or enter a date to keep the start fixed. Equal start and end times record a single collected point. Links and notes are optional; click a linked range to open its source in your browser.
helpCenter.collectionMemo.step.review.de: The original ranges appear below each target's timeline, where you can edit or delete them. Inherited starts display only “Global start time”; view the actual date in timeline settings.
helpCenter.collectionMemo.settings.title: Timeline settings shared by every target
helpCenter.collectionMemo.settings.start: The global start in timeline settings is required. It cannot be in the future or later than the end of a range that inherits it. Blank starts follow changes to this setting. Explicit starts remain fixed, and portions before the global start are outside the visible timeline. The timeline always ends at the current time.
helpCenter.collectionMemo.settings.direc: The current time is on the left by default, with the start on the right. Reverse this in timeline settings. The setting applies to every target without changing the chronological order of records.
helpCenter.collectionMemo.timeline.title: Use the timeline
helpCenter.collectionMemo.timeline.inspe: Hover or focus the timeline to see exact times, links, and notes. Press Enter on a boundary with links to choose a link to open.
helpCenter.collectionMemo.timeline.drag: Drag a collected region's boundary and release to save; press Esc to cancel. A boundary cannot cross the opposite edge, a neighboring region, or the timeline's allowed limits.
helpCenter.collectionMemo.timeline.keybo: Focus a boundary and use arrow keys to adjust by a minute, or hold Shift to adjust by an hour. Home / End move to the earliest / latest allowed time. Left and right arrows follow the displayed timeline direction; up / down move later / earlier in time.
helpCenter.collectionMemo.timeline.fill: Click an uncollected region and confirm it as collected in the popup to fill the gap and merge adjacent ranges.
helpCenter.collectionMemo.timeline.retry: If saving fails, click Retry. If records or the global start have changed, the operation is cancelled; try again using the latest records.
helpCenter.collectionMemo.dates: Dates accept 2026-09-05 16:00, 2026/9/5 16:00, 2026年9月5日 16:00, 202609051600, or ISO formats. Without a time zone, your local zone is used; add Z or an offset such as +08:00 to specify one. A date without a time means local midnight. The end cannot precede the start, and collected times cannot be in the future.
helpCenter.collectionMemo.browsingIntegr: Visited-post integration is pending. Nearby visited posts do not prove that every post between them was collected. A future integration could suggest individual points and let you confirm complete ranges.
